capabilities: Create today's date folder and note using a configurable Moment format with auto-increment on conflicts
Create today's daily note from a configurable template with {{date}}, {{time}} and {{title}} placeholders
Move selected files and folders to a configurable destination folder
Add ribbon buttons that create date notes in multiple configured folders with custom display names
disambiguation: Not a general right-click menu editor; it only adds explorer actions for date folder/note creation and moving items.
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is provided in English and Japanese; installation is manual (place main.js, manifest.json and styles.css in the plugins folder).
problem: Obsidian's explorer right-click menu lacks quick actions for creating date-based folders and notes or batch-moving selected files to a set destination.

relations.evidence: AI title/tag generation has moved to a separate plugin, “AI Note Assistant”.

summary: File explorer context-menu enhancer that creates today's date folders and notes, builds daily notes from a template, and moves selected items.
